common_gates: RULE_OWNER must be exact and BOUND
CAUSAL_USE must be exact and BOUND
NUMERIC specialization requires exact current CALIBRATION authority
NONNUMERIC specialization requires explicit calibration NOT_APPLICABLE basis
constitution currentness does not imply rule currentness
failed positive proof yields UNKNOWN_NOT_PROVEN and never an opposite fact
K3 realized occurrence is not inferred from K1/K2 qualification
K4 active/durative status requires its own lawful current witness path

candidates.invariant_body: For a source-defined objective operation that requires a material resource/access relation, a bound actor/position/context/time may qualify as MATERIAL_ROUTE_AVAILABLE only when type-compatible competent objective evidence proves the required access relation covers the asserted valid-time slice. Lack of proof closes the derivation as unsupported and does not prove NO_ACCESS.
candidates.validity_domain: Exact source-declared operation, resource kind, actor/position binding, world/state version and valid-time interval; no transport across resource type, organization, jurisdiction or period without explicit portability authority.
candidates.witness_contract: Positive K2 requires a current type-specific access witness plus exact reachability/applicability. K1 is not implied. K3 performance/use is not implied. K4 continuing access requires lawful Path A interval evidence or Path B continuing-state support with complete invalidation coverage.
candidates.application_gate: Exact current R1 rule admission plus exact D1 context plus nonempty determinant facts including prerequisite declaration and access-state fact plus exact evidence-witness refs. Missing or stale access closes unsupported.

candidates.invariant_body: A directed obligation may be constituted for an actor/position only when a competent source-owned authority relation proves authority scope, addressee binding, duty content, jurisdiction/context, and valid-time applicability. The rule may derive DIRECTED_OBLIGATION_IN_FORCE and does not infer performance, enforcement, sanction occurrence, subjective acceptance, or motive.
candidates.validity_domain: Exact authority owner, addressee/position, duty content, jurisdiction/context and valid-time interval; no authority inheritance or jurisdictional portability by naming similarity.
candidates.witness_contract: K1 may be PROVEN only from competent operative source-owned rule/state plus exact binding/current validity. K2 permission/route is not implied. K3 compliance/enforcement/sanction occurrence needs separate occurrence evidence. K4 persistence needs a competent interval or continuing-state witness and no defeating closing fact.
candidates.application_gate: Exact current R1 admission plus exact operative authority-source fact plus exact actor/position binding plus valid-time coverage. Revoked, superseded or out-of-scope authority closes unsupported.

candidates.invariant_body: An organized activity route may qualify as objectively available to a bound actor/position only when a competent organization-owned schedule/state proves the activity exists, the asserted interval overlaps an operative availability window, and all source-declared objective applicability/reachability conditions are proved. It never derives attendance or participation.
candidates.validity_domain: One organization/activity type, exact world/state, applicability grain, and declared schedule interval; no inference from a published schedule to realized attendance.
candidates.witness_contract: K2 positive proof requires current availability plus exact actor applicability/reachability. K3 requires separate competent occurrence evidence. K4 recurring/ongoing activity requires owner-declared recurrence/continuing-state semantics and lawful currentness proof.
candidates.application_gate: Exact current R1 admission plus schedule-state determinant plus exact applicability/reachability determinants plus valid-time overlap. Closed schedule, failed applicability, stale witness or missing reachability closes unsupported.

candidates.invariant_body: An institutional eligibility/gate proposition may be constituted only when the competent institution-owned gate rule is operative and every rule-declared objective eligibility predicate for the bound actor/position/context is proved at the asserted valid time. It does not infer treatment receipt, service use, decision outcome, subjective uptake, or future success.
required_determinant_families: one determinant per source-owned required predicate
candidates.validity_domain: Exact institution, gate rule, actor/position class, context/jurisdiction and valid-time interval; no transfer to another institution or gate family without explicit portability authority.
candidates.witness_contract: K1 may be proved from the operative gate rule plus complete objective predicate bindings. K2 route/reachability is separate unless source-constituted. K3 treatment/receipt requires separate occurrence evidence. K4 continuing eligibility needs lawful interval or continuing-state proof with invalidation coverage.
candidates.application_gate: Exact current R1 admission plus current gate-rule determinant plus complete predicate determinant set. Any unknown required predicate yields UNKNOWN_NOT_PROVEN/closed unsupported, not ineligibility.

candidates.invariant_body: A counterpart/channel relation may qualify as objectively available only when a competent source proves the channel relation exists for the exact actor/counterpart/context, the endpoint/channel is operative for the asserted interval, and source-declared reachability conditions are satisfied. It does not infer contact, exchange, receipt, response, support, or subjective experience.
candidates.validity_domain: Exact actor/counterpart pair or role binding, channel type, context/world-state and valid-time interval; no inference across counterpart, channel type or time.
candidates.witness_contract: K2 may be proved by operative channel plus applicability/reachability. K3 contact/exchange requires separate competent occurrence evidence. K4 channel persistence requires interval/continuing-state proof with termination/supersession/invalidation coverage. No social/psychological interpretation follows.
candidates.application_gate: Exact current R1 admission plus counterpart-relation determinant plus channel-state determinant plus reachability determinants. Missing or stale channel evidence closes unsupported and produces no opposite fact.
